identity.address: A2 = A1 = A0 = GND on every card: EEPROM 0x50, temperature 0x48; each card has its own mux branch, so equal addresses never share a bus

permission_placement.decision: Adopted from section 04 section 6.2: WD_M, WD_O, both arm latches, the OPI_TX, OPI_BOE and OPI_OUT latches, the PERMIT_OUT_REQ gate, the DIC_OK filter and the final permission gates on the motion card; tamper latches on the PSM, which owns logic power-on reset; an OUT_EN latch on every output card.
module_reasons: the user's decision puts the FPGA 'with its clock, configuration flash and supervisory circuitry' on the replaceable motion card
every latch input originates on the MC; only permission outputs and EXT_PERMIT, PROCESS_PERMIT, RAILS_OK and TAMPER_N cross a connector, so a connector fault can only remove permission
watchdogs and FPGA are factory-tested and replaced together; the self-test of section 04 section 5.4 runs after every MC replacement
the fixed base stays passive (section 03 D03-1), so no permission silicon can force a base replacement
each receiving card has its own pull-down and its own local AND with presence and power-good

rejected.fixed base: active silicon on the base; a base replacement cannot meet the 5-minute target
rejected.PSM: separates the watchdogs from their WDI sources by two connectors; the PSM keeps only the tamper latches because it owns POR

permission_placement.reconciliation: Section 04 section 6.3 routes MX4 'through the base Ioff buffer'. IS-1 places that Ioff buffer on the motion card (this section governs card boundaries); equations and filters are unchanged.

expansion_terminals.adopted: Section 03 D03-4: M8-M11 and ENC4-ENC11 terminate on the XTB expansion terminal board, fitted once and then part of the fixed wiring; MX4 and EX8 stay replaceable behind it
expansion_terminals.cost: XTB with 136 headers and plugs: estimate $104-167 per expanded unit; carrying the headers on every base instead adds about $35-43 per 8-motor unit
expansion_terminals.usability: twelve-motor units ship with the XTB fitted, so their wiring never changes; a field upgrade fits the XTB once (two studs and one guided connector, no soldering), then the card
expansion_terminals.alternative: all 136 expansion terminals on the base: one wiring diagram for every unit and no XTB part, paid by every 8-motor unit

output_driver_T1.selected: TPS274C65ASRHAR (TI; quad 72 mOhm high-side switch with SPI and integrated ADC; VQFN-40, 6 x 6 mm)

output_driver_T1.evidence: TI datasheet SLVSFZ2C (Feb 2024) downloaded and read 28 Sep 2026; its packaging addendum lists TPS274C65ASRHAR as Active
rows: complete measurement path

CS pin per quad (K(CS) = 300) -> RC -> field-side multichannel ADC -> isolated ADC SPI -> card MCU; channel chosen by SEL1/SEL2 with DIAG_EN; in the drawn design CS reaches only a test point, so no reading reaches software
ISNS -> 10-bit ADC inside the switch -> addressable SPI with device CRC -> ISO7762FDBQR -> card MCU; per-channel current, VOUT, FET temperature and VS
isolation per 8-output card
8 IN + SEL1/SEL2/DIAG_EN (shared) + ADC SPI (3) forward, ADC SDO + 2 FAULT reverse: about 14 forward and 3 reverse channels, four or more isolator packages; the drawn design has no free channel
one ISO7762FDBQR: SCLK, SDI, CS_N, DO_EN forward; SDO and wired-OR FLT reverse; outputs switched by SPI, so no per-channel IN lines cross the barrier
sampling time
one channel per select setting; settling after each select change (time not recorded here) plus one ADC conversion; four channels per device read in sequence
128 us per measurement (Tconv1, datasheet); a full sequential round of 4 channels x 4 quantities is at most 2.05 ms (arithmetic, interpretation, to be measured), inside the 93.05 ms age bound
accuracy at the declared 0.10-0.50 A
K(CS) sense error class +/-8 % recorded at the design point (part-selections, datasheet SLVSCV8E); low-current spread not recorded; plus ADC and settling error

sense-current spread +/-4.7 % at 500 mA, +/-9.9 % at 200 mA, +/-15 % at 100 mA relative to the datasheet min-max midpoint (arithmetic), plus ADC reference 2.72-2.85 V, before per-channel factory calibration; both paths need measurement over 0.10-0.50 A, never one convenient load
transient withstand
48 V transient (< 400 ms) absolute maximum, below the SMCJ30CA 48.4 V reference clamp: an open defect

VS 40 V continuous and 60 V transient (< 1 ms, ON state) absolute maximum (datasheet); the 48.4 V clamp is inside the transient rating only if the clamped surge lasts < 1 ms, and the OFF-state transient is not specified: Codex confirms clamp duration or lowers the clamp
fault behaviour
current limit (+/-15 % for 0.5-7 A, recorded), thermal, FAULT pin

current limit per channel, IS-1 default 0.72 A setting = 0.62-0.82 A (datasheet), inrush setting, thermal, on/off-state open-load and wire-break (on-state threshold 0.38-0.61 mA), short-to-supply, SPI CRC, SPI watchdog, DO_EN disables all outputs
firmware and test effort
ADC driver, select sequencing and settling, per-channel analog calibration, test of every select state and of the analog chain
register driver with CRC, ADC readout, fault registers; per-channel factory calibration at two currents
complete implemented cost

2 x TPS4H160BQPWPRQ1 $2.2172 @100 recorded + field ADC + about three extra isolator packages (ISO7740FDBQR class $1.61 @100 recorded) + select and ADC passives: roughly $6-10 more per card than (b) excluding the driver price difference (estimate)

output_driver_T1.reason: Only the TPS274C65ASRHAR path brings per-output current, open-load, temperature and bank-supply readings to software through one isolated digital link, with a hardware disable pin and a wider transient margin. The ASH variant's extra current-limit settings serve 2 A loads; IS-1 outputs are 0.5 A with a 1.0 A limit maximum.
output_driver_T1.do_en_note: When DO_EN returns high the switch restores the stored SW_STATE, so the card controller writes SW_STATE = 0 and holds CARD_EN low after any permission loss, reset or watchdog trip; an output changes only on a newly accepted command.

replacement_procedure_s: stop the machine; the service commits pending configuration (automatic)
switch off the machine main disconnect / drive power; the service screen asks for this confirmation before it shows any card-removal step (exceptions E1 and E2 of section 04)

switch off controller power and both field entries; wait for the PSM 'safe' LED, or a fixed 60 s when the LED stays dark or the PSM is the failed card (Codex sizes bleeders so every rail is below 5 V within 30 s [REQ])
open the card-cage cover (two captive screws)
release the card's retaining screw and lever it out along its guides
slide the replacement along the same guides until the lever seats; tighten the retaining screw
close the cover
power on: disarmed boot, identification, compatibility verdict and list of required checks
